envelope.batchId: safe sortable identifier matching the file name

item.requestId: lowercase UUID emitted once by WPF and reused as Idempotency-Key
item.requestHash: lowercase SHA-256 of the exact fingerprint
item.bodyJson: exact UTF-8 JSON object string used as the HTTP body

publication.temporaryFile: same pending directory, create-new, write-through, flush-to-disk
publication.commit: same-directory move without overwrite and with write-through

consumer.order: createdAt, then publish mtime, then file name
consumer.dispatch: fixed route with exact bodyJson and Idempotency-Key=requestId
consumer.success: matching receipt for the same requestId and jobId
consumer.failedRetrySourceDismissal: after a matching retry receipt, dismiss the original failed history row before deleting the envelope; matching replay repeats this cleanup idempotently, while canceled source history remains visible
consumer.definitive4xx: move the envelope to needs-action after processing later valid items
consumer.delete: only after every item has a matching durable receipt

jobsStoreIdempotency.payloadRestriction: receipt entries contain no source path, prompt, or request body
jobsStoreIdempotency.atomicity: job transition and receipt creation share one active-store transaction; legacy JSON uses its existing lock and atomic replacement
jobsStoreIdempotency.matchingReplay: return a receipt-only 2xx with the original jobId when the visible job no longer exists
jobsStoreIdempotency.conflictingReplay: return 409 when the same clientRequestId has a different clientRequestHash
jobsStoreIdempotency.capacity: when a new receipt is required at capacity, reject terminal history dismissal with 409 and retain the visible job
jobsStoreIdempotency.compatibility: legacy version-1 stores without the field remain valid
jobsStoreIdempotency.preservation: unknown root and receipt fields round-trip unchanged
jobsStoreIdempotency.integrity: malformed, duplicate, or conflicting receipt state fails closed without replacing or committing the active Jobs store

compatibility.legacyDirectPost: never used by this v1 WPF writer
compatibility.unknownOrLegacyProbe: publish locally and send no POST
compatibility.immediateNudge: allowed only for the exact ready v1 capability
compatibility.rollback: restore the prior WPF and companion together; retain published envelopes
